## Hands-on 1 – The setup check {#hands-on-1-get-yourself-running .smaller}

::: {.small}
**Task 1 – the setup check.** Get to the point where a line of R runs and the data are in front of you.

- **IDE:** your IDE opens its folder, the packages install, `working_script.R` runs its first block, and the report skeleton renders
- **webR workspace:** the page has finished loading, the first chunk runs, and `europeanisation` has 270 rows
:::

::: {.fragment .small}
Take the time you need, **into the next break** if necessary, and raise your hand if you need me.
:::

::: {.fragment .small}
If your installation will not cooperate, do not fight it – open the webR workspace and carry on. Nothing in the tasks depends on which one you use.
:::

::: notes
This first task is about getting to the point where a line of R runs and the data are in front of you. In the IDE workspace, open its folder, let the packages install, run the first block of the working script and render the report skeleton once, so that you know it works. In the webR workspace, wait for the page to finish loading, run the first chunk and check that the panel has two hundred and seventy rows. [advance] Take the time that you need, into the next break if necessary, since getting this right now saves an hour later, and raise your hand if you need me. [advance] If the IDE workspace will not cooperate, switch to the webR workspace and carry on, because nothing in the tasks depends on which one you use.
:::
